notes: Transcribed from the text of 21 CFR 312.23 as served by the eCFR API for 2026-04-09, and from the CTD section trees in ICH M4Q(R1) and M4S(R2). An IND is a thinner submission than a marketing application, so a 'missing' finding here is a prompt to check, never a defect: 21 CFR 312.23(a)(7)(i) scales the expected content with the phase of the investigation.

requirements.title: Drug substance described with its physical, chemical or biological characteristics

citation.document: 21 CFR 312.23(a)(7)(iv)(a) - IND content and format, drug substance

requirements.expectation: A reviewer looks for the identity of the drug substance and its physical, chemical or biological characteristics - nomenclature, structure, and physicochemical properties - not only a trade name.

requirements.title: Name and address of the drug substance manufacturer

citation.document: 21 CFR 312.23(a)(7)(iv)(a) - IND content and format, drug substance

requirements.expectation: The regulation asks for the name and address of the drug substance manufacturer, by name - a facility that is only described ('our contract manufacturer') does not satisfy it.

requirements.title: General method of preparation of the drug substance

citation.document: 21 CFR 312.23(a)(7)(iv)(a) - IND content and format, drug substance

requirements.expectation: A general description of how the substance is made: the synthetic or manufacturing route, starting materials and reagents. Final process detail is not expected at IND stage.

requirements.title: Acceptable limits and analytical methods for identity, strength, quality and purity

citation.document: 21 CFR 312.23(a)(7)(iv)(a) - IND content and format, drug substance

requirements.expectation: A specification: the tests, the analytical methods behind them, and numeric acceptance criteria assuring identity, strength, quality and purity of the substance.

requirements.title: Stability of the drug substance over the toxicological and clinical studies

citation.document: 21 CFR 312.23(a)(7)(ii) and (a)(7)(iv)(a) - stability data in all phases

requirements.expectation: Stability information sufficient to support the substance through the toxicology studies and the planned clinical studies: storage condition, duration covered, and the batches on stability.

requirements.title: Components and quantitative composition of the drug product

citation.document: 21 CFR 312.23(a)(7)(iv)(b) - IND content and format, drug product

requirements.expectation: All components used to manufacture the product, including those that do not appear in it, with the quantitative composition where applicable and any expected variations.

requirements.title: Drug product manufacturer, and description of manufacturing and packaging

citation.document: 21 CFR 312.23(a)(7)(iv)(b) - IND content and format, drug product

requirements.expectation: The name and address of the product manufacturer plus a brief general description of the manufacturing and packaging procedure appropriate to the product.

requirements.title: Acceptable limits and analytical methods for the drug product

citation.document: 21 CFR 312.23(a)(7)(iv)(b) - IND content and format, drug product

requirements.expectation: A product specification with its analytical methods, and information sufficient to assure product stability through the planned clinical studies.

requirements.title: Pharmacological effects, mechanism of action, and ADME
requirements.expectation: The pharmacological effects and mechanism of action in animals, plus absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion where known.

requirements.title: Integrated summary of the toxicological effects in animals and in vitro

citation.document: 21 CFR 312.23(a)(8)(ii)(a) - integrated summary of toxicological effects

requirements.expectation: An integrated summary rather than a stack of study reports: acute, subacute and chronic toxicity, reproductive and developmental effects, route-specific toxicity, and in vitro toxicity, read together.

requirements.title: Identification and qualifications of the individuals who evaluated the studies
requirements.expectation: Named individuals with their qualifications, who evaluated the nonclinical results and concluded it is reasonably safe to begin the proposed investigations. This is a people fact; no drafting tool can supply it.

requirements.title: Where the studies were conducted and where the records are available for inspection
requirements.expectation: A statement of where the investigations were conducted and where the records are available for inspection. Another people-and-place fact that has to come from the sponsor.

requirements.title: GLP compliance statement, or a stated reason for non-compliance, per study
requirements.expectation: For each nonclinical laboratory study subject to 21 CFR part 58, either a statement that it complied with GLP or a brief statement of why it did not.

requirements.title: Full data tabulation for each study supporting the proposed investigation

citation.document: 21 CFR 312.23(a)(8)(ii)(b) - full tabulation of data suitable for detailed review

requirements.expectation: For each toxicology study intended primarily to support the safety of the proposed clinical investigation, a full tabulation of the data suitable for detailed review.
